scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mafia/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mafia/server" "npm run dev -w @mafia/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mafia/shared && npm run build -w @mafia/server && npm run build -w @mafia/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mafia/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mafia/server && npm run typecheck -w @mafia/web
